candidates.excerpt: Imran Khan has been asked by the FRRO to leave India by October 28, raising legal concerns. Lawyers argue that he did not participate in the protest and only passed through the area. The police have charged the protestors for illegal assembly due to lacking permission for the demonstration. Legal representatives plan to seek CCTV footage to support Khan's claims regarding his involvement.

candidates.title: Absconding in UP bizman murder case, accused model Shraddha Dubey may be in Nepal
candidates.excerpt: The investigation into Shiva Sharma's death has led authorities to search for Shraddha Dubey across borders. CCTV footage reportedly shows Shraddha, her sister Rashmi, and an associate Adil in Nepal. They are believed to have fled Lucknow soon after the incident, raising suspicion. Sharma's family has alleged foul play, while Dubey maintains her innocence and claims he died by suicide.
